meaning.zh:
“这真是太棒了” 或 “太厉害了”。

"That's wicked" 是一种俚语，最早起源于英国，后在美国特别是波士顿地区广泛使用。虽然 "wicked" 本意是 “邪恶的”，但在这种用法中却表示极好或令人印象深刻，这种用法可能源自青少年亚文化的语言现象，利用反义词创造新的表达方式。
meaning.en: This slang phrase originated in the UK and later became widely used in the US, especially in the Boston area. Although "wicked" originally means "evil," in this context it means extremely good or impressive. This usage perhaps evolved through youth subculture language practices, where antonyms were used to create new expressions.

lines.zh: 那场演唱会真是太棒了！

lines.en: Wow, your skateboard tricks are wicked!
lines.zh: 哇，你的滑板技巧真是太厉害了！

lines.en: The special effects in that movie were wicked!
lines.zh: 那部电影的特效真是太酷了！
